class.name: EditorExportPlatformWindowsNT6
class.brief_description: Editor export platform targeting Windows NT 6.1 and later.
class.description: Describes export settings for Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, and Windows Server 2008 R2. Essentially, Windows from the 2010s decade.

members.member: The CPU architecture of the exported executable. Can be [code]x86_32[/code] or [code]x86_64[/code]. Defaults to [code]x86_64[/code].
If [code]true[/code], embeds the project's PCK file in the exported executable instead of creating a separate [code].pck[/code] file.
Path to a custom debug export template. If empty, the platform's default debug template is used.
Path to a custom release export template. If empty, the platform's default release template is used.

Controls when a console wrapper executable is exported alongside the main executable, allowing the project to run with console output. Set to [code]0[/code] to disable, [code]1[/code] for debug exports only, or [code]2[/code] for both debug and release exports.

Controls when a separate debug symbols file is exported alongside the executable. Set to [code]0[/code] to disable, [code]1[/code] for debug exports only, or [code]2[/code] for both debug and release exports. Requires a matching [code].debugsymbols[/code] file or [code].debugsymbols.zip[/code] archive beside the export template.
If [code]true[/code], compiles shaders during export and embeds them in the exported project. Requires the Forward+ or Mobile renderer and is ignored for dedicated server exports.
If [code]true[/code], includes ETC2/ASTC-compressed textures in the exported project.
If [code]true[/code], includes S3TC/BPTC-compressed textures in the exported project.
